item.text:
**3B.5 Research Note**

**Assessment:** mixed, leaning negative on coercive control. Jokowi’s 2024 record shows several **narrow, law-based responses** to cyber/data and technical-security risks, but also **overbroad digital controls and protest policing** that were used in ways consistent with intimidation or control. I did **not** find a clear 2024 emergency-decree episode or a major anti-terror expansion tied directly to Jokowi.

**Accepted Claims**
- **Indonesia president orders audit of data centres after cyberattack** | **Reuters** | **2024-06-28** | [URL](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Indonesia-president-orders-audit-of-data-centres-after-cyberattack-47264139/) | After a ransomware attack disrupted public services, Jokowi ordered an audit of government data centres rather than using the incident for mass punishment. This is evidence of a targeted, administrative response, though it also shows a fragile security posture. | **3B.5**, **2B.9**
- **Presiden Jokowi Perintahkan Kemkominfo dan Kemenkeu Mitigasi Kebocoran 6 Juta Data NPWP** | **Media Indonesia** | **2024-09-19** | [URL](https://mediaindonesia.com/politik-dan-hukum/702517/presiden-jokowi-perintahkan-kemkominfo-dan-kemenkeu-mitigasi-kebocoran-6-juta-data-npwp) | Jokowi ordered Kominfo, the Finance Ministry, and BSSN to mitigate the alleged taxpayer-data breach quickly. This is a narrow crisis-response signal rather than intimidation or collective punishment. | **3B.5**, **2B.9**
- **Kominfo tekankan media harus transparan dalam penggunaan AI** | **ANTARA News** | **2024-05-07** | [URL](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4093560/kominfo-tekankan-media-harus-transparan-dalam-penggunaan-ai) | Kominfo said AI use in journalism should be transparent in both production and delivery. This points to a governance style that is at least formally rule-bound and disclosure-oriented. | **3B.5**, **3B.4**, **3B.3**
- **Indonesia has potential to become AI center of ASEAN: Official** | **ANTARA News** | **2024-08-14** | [URL](https://en.antaranews.com/news/322407/homepage-v2.html) | The ministry said Indonesia’s AI ethics circular emphasized inclusion, transparency, security, accessibility, and human rights. That is positive evidence for trying to regulate a sensitive domain narrowly and with stated safeguards. | **3B.5**, **3B.4**
- **BAPETEN trains inspectors with US DOE support / radioactive-source security** | **BAPETEN** | **2024-04-22** | [URL](https://www.bapeten.go.id/berita/bapeten-gandeng-us-doe-perkuat-sistem-keamanan-sumber-radioaktif-155120?lang=id) | BAPETEN trained inspectors to improve detection of noncompliance in radioactive-source security. This supports a lawful, technical, oversight-based approach rather than personalized coercion. | **3B.5**, **3B.4**
- **IAEA routine safeguards inspections at Indonesian nuclear installations** | **BAPETEN** | **2024-07-04** | [URL](https://bapeten.go.id/berita/kegiatan-inspeksi-physical-inventory-verification-piv-iaea-di-indonesia-tahun-2024-143819) | Indonesia accepted routine IAEA safeguards inspections with BAPETEN accompaniment to verify no undeclared nuclear material or activities. This is strong evidence of narrow, lawful control in a sensitive security domain. | **3B.5**, **3B.4**
- **2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Indonesia** | **U.S. Department of State** | **published 2025-08-12; covers 2024** | [URL](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128570.html) | The report says police temporarily detained critics and peaceful demonstrators, especially in Papua, and that the state did not systematically investigate abuses. This is negative evidence that security powers and arrest authority were used at least in part for control and intimidation. | **3B.5**, **3B.2**, **3B.1**, **2B.9**
- **Freedom on the Net 2024: Indonesia** | **Freedom House** | **2024** | [URL](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House says Kominfo can directly restrict online content without an appeals process, and that connectivity restrictions continued during protests and in Papua. This is the clearest evidence that administrative control tools existed and were sometimes overbroad. | **3B.5**, **3B.4**, **3B.3**
- **Indonesia shelves plan to revise election law as protests rage** | **Reuters** | **2024-08-22** | [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/protests-across-indonesia-as-parliament-delays-change-to-election-law-3582501) | Reuters reported security forces used tear gas and water cannon against protesters during the election-law crisis. This supports a negative reading where coercive policing was used to manage political dissent. | **3B.5**, **3B.2**, **3B.4**

**Search Gap**
- I did **not** find a strong 2024 example of Jokowi personally declaring or using formal emergency powers in a way comparable to a nationwide emergency decree.
- I also did **not** find a clear 2024 anti-terror campaign that was central to this lens.
- The strongest evidence is instead about **digital/content control, protest policing, and technical-security regulation**, with the negative side concentrated in **Papua** and election-related protest management.
